meta.route: NOT FOUND — no equivalent of Zone 6's 'ข้อมูลเอกภาพ' amphoe-comparison PDF page could be located on zone11.oae.go.th by any method tried.
findings: zone11's OWN internal search for 'เอกภาพ' (16 hits) confirms the office is actively engaged in the national ekaparb data-unification initiative, but every hit is a news/process post, never a finished district-level data table.

The two province-level commodity dashboards ('แดชบอร์ดสินค้าเกษตรพืชไร่รายจังหวัด' and '...พืชสวนรายจังหวัด') are the closest thing zone11 has to a structured crop-data product; they were NOT extracted because (a) they are live interactive dashboards, not PDFs, and (b) their titles indicate province-level, not amphoe-level, granularity — extracting them would require a different (dashboard-scraping) approach outside this sweep's PDF-matching scope.
No wp-content/uploads PDF matching a crop x amphoe comparison table was found via any discovery path.
meta.conclusion: Zone 11 does not appear to publish a public, amphoe-level 'ข้อมูลเอกภาพ' PDF series (or, if it exists, it is not linked from any page/sitemap/search-index this session could reach). No rows extracted — nothing to parse. No fabrication.
